(rule! (lambda (grid)
         (let* ((h (rows grid))
                (w (cols grid))
                (objs (objects grid 0))
                (frames (filter (lambda (o)
                                  (let* ((bb (obj-bbox o))
                                         (bh (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))))
                                         (bw (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb)))))
                                    (< (obj-size o) (* bh bw))))
                                objs))
                (frame-info (map (lambda (o)
                                   (let ((bb (obj-bbox o)))
                                     (list (obj-color o) (first bb) (second bb))))
                                 frames))
                (rows-list (map second frame-info))
                (cols-list (map (lambda (f) (list-ref f 2)) frame-info))
                (row-range (- (max-list rows-list) (min-list rows-list)))
                (col-range (- (max-list cols-list) (min-list cols-list)))
                (vertical (> row-range col-range))
                (sorted-frames (sort-by frame-info
                                        (lambda (f)
                                          (if vertical (second f) (list-ref f 2)))))
                (n (length sorted-frames)))
           (if vertical
               (build-grid (* n 3)
                           3
                           (r c)
                           (let* ((idx (quotient r 3))
                                  (lr (remainder r 3))
                                  (lc c)
                                  (color (first (list-ref sorted-frames idx))))
                             (if (or (zero? lr) (= lr 2) (zero? lc) (= lc 2)) color 0)))
               (build-grid 3
                           (* n 3)
                           (r c)
                           (let* ((idx (quotient c 3))
                                  (lr r)
                                  (lc (remainder c 3))
                                  (color (first (list-ref sorted-frames idx))))
                             (if (or (zero? lr) (= lr 2) (zero? lc) (= lc 2)) color 0)))))))
